description: The product of the first divergence: what was found when the question was held open, before anything was chosen. divergence_breadth and unknowns are both required — a brief that reports only its findings makes a narrow exploration and an exhaustive one look identical, and the definition phase would converge on the narrow one without knowing it.

observations.description: What was found, each with the locator it was found through.

locator.description: Tool plus path or query that produced this observation.

audience_segments.description: Distinguishable groups the question lands differently for.

unmet_needs.description: Needs the current state does not serve. Findings, not proposals.

adjacent_questions.description: Questions the exploration surfaced that the posed question did not contain.

divergence_breadth.description: How far the exploration actually reached, judged against the material available rather than against effort spent.

unknowns.description: What the exploration could not determine. Required: the honest bound of the divergence.
